purpose: Local exploratory Python adapter optimization; same optimized native core in both arms
clock: Invented grid: observations at 10*t, decisions at 10*t+1
order: Fresh serial worker per arm, alternate baseline/candidate by trial
gate: All prediction bytes equal; each trial p50 improves; median paired p50 reduction >=5%; median paired p99 increase <=10%
timing: FeatureReplay.advance including snapshot, conversion, native prediction, decision construction; exclude tape/model construction
limits: One synthetic tape and one saved model on local Intel Mac; no live ingress or universal tail bound
